meta.title: A section-numbering error from the server is shown as a toast
gaps: Enable boq_in_erfx_allowed; the catalog cannot change tenant settings, so the gate must already be ON.
Upload a BOQ sheet starting at section B: upload supports only fixed sample fixtures and cannot construct or select this malformed BOQ sheet.
Trigger and verify the toast "Invalid section, current section B, expected section A, Please Add Valid one"; the required invalid upload is unavailable.
Assert exact equality between the toast and the API response message; the catalog has no response-message comparison assertion.
Verify that the BOQ grid remains unchanged after this rejected upload; the required upload cannot be performed.
